text:
Maria L: Quick design question — attaching updated mock for batch re-run + status. https://img.redwood/mock123.png
Kevin T: Love the progress strip. Can we add keyboard shortcut to start selected re-run? suggested `Shift+R` or `r`? :sparkles:
Oliver: A11y: the progress colors lack 3:1 on hover — also need aria-live region for status updates. screen reader will miss inline badges.
Sara P: Modal copy suggestion: "Rerun selected prompts — results may overwrite existing annotations. Continue?" maybe change 'overwrite' -> 'append results to history'?
Maria L: Good call, Sara. We want overwrite by default but preserve previous run in history. So new copy: "Rerun selected prompts. New results will replace current annotations; previous runs saved to history. Continue?"
Kevin T: For UX flow, show per-item live status and a top-level progress count (e.g., 12/48). Keep cancel button sticky.
Lee (prod): Telemetry needs events: batch_rerun.started/finished/cancelled + per_prompt.status. Also guard for rate limits -> fallback variant. Add SLA note for Dedicated customers.
Oliver: Also keyboard navigation: tab order must skip hidden controls. propose `Shift+R` to kickoff and `Esc` to cancel modal. add aria-labels for each status chip: "Prompt 12: running, 45%".
Maria L: Can we try the compact list with inline diff toggles instead of expanding rows? designers want to avoid page jumps.
Sara P: Copy tweak for empty state after rerun: "No regressions found in this run" vs "No diffs" — prefer 'regressions' for clarity.
design-bot: Summary saved to /design/threads/2005001111 — action items: 1) implement aria-live + status labels (Oliver) 2) modal copy update (Sara) 3) keyboard shortcuts (Kevin) 4) telemetry events (Lee) 5) compact inline diffs prototype (Maria). :white_check_mark:
Kevin T: Will mock up keyboard hint in top-right (small tooltip) and add settings toggle to enable/disable shortcuts.
Oliver: I'll run a quick axe scan once prototype lands.
Maria L: Thanks all — can we aim for a prototype by EOD Friday? If not, next Wed is fine.
Lee (prod): EOD Friday works for me.
Sara P: I'll update copy and push to Figma now.
Kevin T: putting a short PR for shortcut handler.
Maria L: 👍
